question.worked_solution:
The table shows probabilities in the form $P(X\ge x).$ So first, we express the desired probability in this form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge x) & =1-P(X\le x) \\  & =1-0.9 \\  & =0.1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since $X∼{T}_{10},$ we focus on the row of the table that corresponds to $k=10.$

| $k∖p$ | $0.100$ | $0.050$ | $0.025$ | $0.010$ | $0.005$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $8$ | $1.397$ | $1.860$ | $2.306$ | $2.896$ | $3.355$ |
| $9$ | $1.383$ | $1.833$ | $2.262$ | $2.821$ | $3.250$ |
| $10$ | $1.372$ | $1.812$ | $2.228$ | $2.764$ | $3.169$ |

From this row, we see that

$$
P(X\ge 1.372)=0.100.
$$

Therefore, our answer is $x=1.372.$
